scope: Software-only adapter for Einstein HBM SU fused runtime; not native ISA, numerical proof, hardware measurement or adoption
api: compile_saved(Path(existing_pickle)); cases.load_cases(Path(existing_pickle)) returns unchanged saved arrays/operations

p6om_ildr.json.scope: existing HBM six-position op-major saved cases

original_norm.json.scope: retained original source demonstrates required hcpost redsq fallback; not a new HBM numerical measurement

runtime_contract: Load the exact saved pickle by SHA256; expected arrays and initial/CR bits come from that pickle unchanged.
original_ops and original_op_indexes retain original issue/reduction/rounding order, including noncontiguous interleaved groups; descriptors are not a replacement scheduler.
selected means a fully matched software candidate, never adopted hardware. Unknown controls, missing operands or interfering VM operations retain original ops.
hc_post with saved redsq is an unselected candidate; retain its WHOLE original group. No dead-consumer proof is inferred.
Checks include original labels/addresses/counts/kinds and hashes of expected little-endian binary32 words; no oracle runs.
Index_q export supports the exact saved two-op contract: original-Q untouched heads plus saved-O rotated tails per head, scaled weights with saved BF16 rounding. No weights quantization.
No saved index_q SU case pickle was available in the consumed inputs. index_q capability is implemented but no actual index_q enrollment/result is claimed.
No MTP, tau, rates, clock or new cost assumptions are emitted. Maxwell owns composition; Einstein owns parent/runtime.
